raw_text: Maven parent `pom.xml`; modules: `ecommerce-common`, `user-service`, `product-service`, `inventory-service`, `cart-service`, `order-service`, `payment-service`, `shipping-service`. Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker. Build: `mvn clean package`; service + deps: `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; run: `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; jar: `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; stack: `docker compose up --build`. Standard Maven layout; tests in `<module>/src/test/java`; config `src/main/resources/application.yml`. 4-space Java, one public class/file; package `com.example.ecommerce.<service>`; lowerCamelCase, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; reuse shared types. JUnit 5, `spring-boot-starter-test`; `*Test`, `*IT`; run `mvn test` or `mvn -pl order-service test`. Conventional Commits with module scope. PR: summary, modules, API examples, schema/config notes; ensure tests pass. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables. Local DB: `jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/ecommerce`, user/password `ecommerce`.
